name.ja: ねこぶそう3 舟盛り

description.ja: 話題のねこぶそう、第３弾が参ります！外装パーツ４種と、このセットでないと手に入らないねこの大まんぞくセット。
description.en: The third installment of the popular Nekobusou is here! A set of 4 types of exterior parts and a big cat bun that you can only get with this set.

description.ja: • １～２弾に引き続き、ねこの原型はねこ造形作家の森口修氏が制作。
description.en: • Continuing from 1st and 2nd editions, the cat prototype was created by cat sculptor Osamu Moriguchi.

description.ja: • ぶそうはイラストレーター・漫画家といて活動中の二条忠則氏が担当。
description.en: • Buso is in charge of Mr. Tadanori Nijo, who is active as an illustrator and manga artist.

description.ja: • ねこは、新規造形の長毛種ねこ。ジャケットも新規造形の洗濯カゴ型で、取っ手が可動。
description.en: • The cat is a newly designed long-haired cat. The jacket is also a newly designed laundry basket type, with a movable handle.

description.ja: • 中盛りA～Dのぶそうパーツ一式やボーナスパーツの入ったまさに「舟盛り」なセット。ぶそうパーツは舟盛り専用カラー。
description.en: • A truly "fun-sized" set that includes a set of medium-sized parts A to D and bonus parts. The Buso parts have a color exclusively for Funamori.

description.ja: • パーツを簡単に取り外せるセパレーターを同梱。
description.en: • Includes a separator that allows you to easily remove parts.

contents.ja:
彩色済ねこフィギュア×1
ジャケット×1
ぶそう×1式
パーツセパレーター×1
contents.en: Painted cat figure x 1 Jacket x 1 Busho x 1 set Parts separator x 1
